articles.description: Russia's Defense Ministry has released new footage claiming its Geran kamikaze drones are targeting fuel stations used to supply Ukrainian forces, aiming to disrupt Kyiv's battlefield logistics. The Geran drone, widely believed to be based on the Iranian Shahed-136, has become a key weapon in Russia's long-range strike campaign. The developments come as Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warns that Russia could launch a fresh wave of missile strikes within the next 48 hours, citing intelligence reports of possible attacks and an expected increase in Russian troop numbers.
